title: Open scalar balancing preserves the actual unit on a Grothendieck topos
statement:
Let $T$ be a Grothendieck topos with a fixed presentation by a site small in the universe of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-topos]. Let $u$ be a subterminal object of $T$ (an object with a monomorphism $u\to1$), put $V=T/u$, and let $j:V\hookrightarrow T$ be its localization morphism. Let $a:R\to S$ be a unital map of sheaves of commutative rings on $T$, with restricted rings $R_V=j^{-1}R$ and $S_V=j^{-1}S$. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(R)$ and $D(S)$ of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $L_{j,R}$ and $L_{j,S}$ for exact restriction to $V$. Suppose $I_{j,R}\dashv L_{j,R}$ and $I_{j,S}\dashv L_{j,S}$ are the exact extension-by-zero adjunctions obtained by sheafifying the extension presheaf, with their actual units $\eta_{j,R}:1\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{j,R}I_{j,R}$ and $\eta_{j,S}:1\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{j,S}I_{j,S}$; the extension functors are fully faithful. On a presentation these extensions have the direct-sum formula over sections of $u$ given in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-sheaf-slice-adjunction]. Put $E_T=-\otimes_R^LS$ and $E_V=-\otimes_{R_V}^LS_V$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Let $\lambda_j:L_{j,S}E_T\xrightarrow{\sim}E_VL_{j,R}$ be canonical tensor/restriction balancing [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. The ordinary balancing maps $[m]_f\otimes s\mapsto[m\otimes s|_f]_f$, where $f$ indexes an extension-presheaf summand, induce a natural isomorphism of $S$-linear derived functors $\beta_j:E_TI_{j,R}\xrightarrow{\sim}I_{j,S}E_V$. Its normalization for every $M\in D(R_V)$ is
$$\eta_{j,S,E_VM}^{-1}\,L_{j,S}(\beta_{j,M})=E_V(\eta_{j,R,M}^{-1})\,\lambda_{j,I_{j,R}M}.$$
Equivalently, $\beta_{j,M}^{-1}$ is the $I_{j,S}\dashv L_{j,S}$ adjunct of $\lambda_{j,I_{j,R}M}^{-1}E_V(\eta_{j,R,M})$. No flatness of $a$, boundedness of $M$, enough-points hypothesis, or scheme presentation is assumed.

proof.text: Use the ordinary coefficient adjunctions. Restriction of scalars commutes with element-site restriction by the identity map on every section. The composites I_R followed by scalar extension and scalar extension followed by I_S therefore have canonically isomorphic right adjoints. Uniqueness of left adjoints produces tau. The Hom equivalence of this uniqueness map identifies the two composites of units. Evaluating at (U,f,m) gives the formula with scalar 1, and S-linearity gives the formula for every scalar.

Construct rho using ordinary scalar extension commuting with continuous cocontinuous element-site precomposition and its sheafification-unit formula. Subterminality of A makes its section sets subsingletons; the direct-sum open unit is then its unique summand inclusion. The actual unit is invertible after sheafification and exact localization.

Apply the derived-from-ordinary result to the proved rho and tau and their section formulas. Insert tau and its formula into the existential conclusion. The last adjunct equation follows from the supplied unit coherence: write the Hom transpose as the actual unit followed by restriction of beta inverse, substitute the unit-coherence equation, combine the two restrictions of beta and beta inverse, and cancel their composite identity.
